stem:
Lalit reads a salt packet labelled "pure." The contents list salt and a small amount of another substance.

Which claim matches the scientific meaning of pure?

options.text: This material is not a pure substance because more than one substance is present.
This material is a pure substance because the label says pure.
This material is a pure substance because the salt looks white.
This material is an element because the label says pure.

teacher.key_rationale: In science a pure substance has no other substance mixed in. A consumer label is not that test. Colour is not that test. Calling it an element swaps terms.
